changes: Added materialHash-based verification evidence freshness. New evidence records a hash of tracked non-story-metadata files, coverage prefers materialHash freshness, and old headHash-only evidence still uses the legacy metadata-only diff fallback. Expanded verification-freshness smoke coverage for metadata-only and material changes.
usage: Run koala verification_evidence_add as usual. After metadata-only commits such as findings or summary updates, koala validate --story=<storyId> keeps coverage covered. If source, tests, config, package, or requirements files change, evidence becomes stale.
limitations: Existing evidence without materialHash remains compatible but still depends on the legacy headHash diff fallback. Non-git projects omit materialHash and keep prior behavior.
pitfalls: The first ad-hoc evidence was recorded before the code commit, so final evidence had to be re-recorded at the implementation HEAD. Worktree needed a local node_modules symlink to run tsc because dependencies live in the main checkout.
